diagnostics.message: :data.http.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

data.http.wait_for_cluster has an explicit depends_on entry for aws_eks_cluster.this, but this dependency is already established implicitly: the data source's `url` attribute references `aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint` and its `ca_certificate` attribute references `aws_eks_cluster.this[*].certificate_authority[0].data`, so Terraform cannot read this data source until the cluster exists. The explicit entry can be removed (the second entry, aws_security_group_rule.cluster_private_access, is not redundant and should be kept).
